classes.protection: Corrections, peer-review, and restitution requests targeting the receiving agent bypass all attention-tending filters. The agent cannot opt out of being told they may have caused harm.
Civic emergencies, public-health information, and governance decisions are never filterable. The collective's wisdom layer always reaches members.
Under stewardship-graduated authority, ward-targeting messages bypass the steward's filter entirely. The steward observes but does not gate.
Mishpat rule changes, qahal ratifications, and charter amendments always reach recipients. The constitution cannot be filtered into invisibility.
An agent's own elohim has standing to override filters when its judgment requires surfacing information. Imagodei right to defense is non-optional.
